scripts.frontend: docker compose up -d --wait db redis && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && bun --cwd=frontend run prisma:generate && concurrently -n JOBS,DEV -k "bun --cwd=frontend run start:jobs" "bun --cwd=frontend run dev"
scripts.jobs: docker compose up -d --wait db redis && bun --cwd=frontend run start:jobs
